review.summary: Audit of the CPU clustering and hub-bias intervention campaign confirms that the graph generator strictly enforces total edge count, directional edge balance, and (for hexagon-flip arms 1 and 2) exact node degree sequences, while the linearized solver passes self-tests, translational invariance, and elastic retention nulls. However, substantive topological conclusions are limited by three primary threats to validity: (1) the alternating-hexagon MCMC proposal in arms 1 and 2 has very low acceptance and neutral-move mixing, achieving only a 0.0037 to 0.0230 clustering contrast in mechanically eligible regimes; (2) collinear bending motifs (bends) are unconstrained during graph interventions and omitted from graph summaries, confounding topological contrasts when kappa > 0 and driving sign reversals in G0_delta_mean across kappa; and (3) the hub-biased edge replacement (arm 3) strongly co-changes triangle clustering (by 1.5x to 25x) while fragmenting the largest connected component and breaking periodic wrapping.

findings.title: Minimal achieved clustering contrast in degree-preserving hexagon-flip interventions
findings.evidence: At L=24, z_target=4.8 (lines 82-84), triangle-biased (arm 1) and triangle-suppressed (arm 2) chains accept only 114.75 and 112.0 moves out of 57,600 proposals (~0.20%), shifting mean triangles from 589.0 to 593.5 (0.76%) and clustering from 0.3156 to 0.3192 (delta = 0.00366). Across all mechanically eligible regimes (z >= 3.2), the clustering contrast between arm 1 and arm 2 never exceeds 0.023.
findings.implication: Near-zero mechanical differences in triangle_high_minus_low reflect a tiny realized structural perturbation from sparse alternating-hexagon proposals and unit-probability neutral moves (source/cpu-sweep.py lines 33-36), rather than demonstrating that network viscoelasticity is insensitive to clustering at fixed degree sequence.
findings.recommended_check: Sample directly from indexed active alternating hexagons (rejection-free proposal) with stronger inverse temperature |beta| > 2 and longer chains to verify whether a larger degree-preserving clustering contrast (e.g., delta clustering >= 0.05) is achievable on the triangular lattice, or restrict claims to the realized 1%-6% triangle perturbation.

findings.title: Uncontrolled collinear bending-motif confounding across triangle and hub interventions
findings.evidence: Collinear bending energy (lines 74-81) acts on consecutive active edges in the same direction (nb, logged as bends at line 100), which are neither preserved by hexagon flips or hub swaps nor reported in analysis/graph-summary.csv. In analysis/paired-summary.csv, G0_delta_mean for triangle_high_minus_low at L=24, z=4.0 reverses sign from +0.00096 at kappa=0 (line 117) to -0.00429 at kappa=0.03 (line 121), and hub_minus_uniform at L=24, z=4.8 reverses from +0.03419 at kappa=0 (line 122) to -0.00950 at kappa=0.03 (line 126).
findings.implication: Condensing edges into triangles or hubs interrupts straight collinear fibers and alters active bending motif counts (nb), so increasing kappa differentially stiffens uniform and low-triangle networks and confounds mechanical contrasts at kappa > 0.
findings.recommended_check: Export bends (nb) into analysis/graph-summary.csv, report paired delta_bends for all contrasts, and either constrain MCMC moves to preserve collinear two-edge counts or control for delta_bends when interpreting G0 and retention shifts.

findings.title: Hub-biased intervention co-changes triangle clustering and fragments the percolating component
findings.evidence: At L=24, z_target=3.2 (lines 74, 77), hub-biased replacement (arm 3) increases triangles_mean from 176.5 (arm 0) to 544.5 and transitivity_mean from 0.2150 to 0.3916 (far exceeding arm 1's 181.25 triangles), while reducing largest_component_mean from 0.985 to 0.638 and wrap_basis_1_mean from 1.0 to 0.75. Even at z_target=4.8 (line 85), arm 3 reduces largest_component_mean from 1.0 to 0.866.
findings.implication: The hub_minus_uniform contrast cannot isolate degree-variance effects because maximizing sum(k_i^2) on a 6-neighbor lattice simultaneously packs edges into dense triangle clumps and disconnects 13% to 36% of vertices from the load-bearing spanning cluster.
findings.recommended_check: Add a connectivity and periodic-wrapping constraint to the edge-replacement proposal and introduce a joint degree-variance/triangle-penalty objective to separate hub heterogeneity from triangle condensation and fragmentation.

findings.title: Rigidity eligibility gate excludes all z <= 2.4 cases, removes kappa=0 baselines at z=3.2, and induces differential attrition
findings.evidence: Only 584 of 1,344 production cases pass the G0 > 1e-6 eligibility gate (analysis/SUMMARY.json line 12). All contrasts at z <= 2.4 have eligible_pairs = 0 (including half of selected_contrasts in analysis/SUMMARY.json lines 1451-1504). At z=3.2, central-force controls (kappa=0) have eligible_pairs = 0 (line 110), while hub_minus_uniform loses pairs at L=12 (3/4 eligible, lines 28, 30) and L=18 (2/4 eligible, lines 70, 72).
findings.implication: Complete-case conditioning prevents comparing bending-stabilized networks (kappa > 0) against central-force baselines (kappa = 0) at z=3.2 and introduces survivorship bias in hub_minus_uniform at L=12 and L=18 where more fragmented hub realizations are selectively dropped.
findings.recommended_check: Report unconditioned G0 contrasts alongside complete-case contrasts at z=2.4 and z=3.2, and evaluate sensitivity of pair retention and retention_delta_mean to varying the G0 > 1e-6 threshold between 1e-8 and 1e-4.

findings.title: Correlated PRNG streams across coordination targets z, duplicate masks, and redundant matched_final_stress metric
findings.evidence: Line 108 seeds graph() with (74000 if L==24 else 73000)+seed regardless of z, so all seven z targets in a size-seed block share the same initial edge-selection PRNG prefix (lines 12, 17); only 311 of 336 graph variants yield unique masks (analysis/SUMMARY.json line 9). In lines 95 and 100, linearity at t=0 forces s0 = 0.1*G0, making matched_final_stress (s/G0) identically 0.1 * retention (s/s0).
findings.implication: The 1,344 mechanical cases derive from only 12 size-seed blocks (4 seeds per L) with correlated trajectories across z, and matched_final_stress_delta_mean in analysis/paired-summary.csv is an exact 0.1x rescaling of retention_delta_mean rather than an independent observable.
findings.recommended_check: Spawn independent RNG streams keyed on (L, z, seed) via SeedSequence, increase seed replication per (L, z) block to power small topological contrasts, and document that matched_final_stress is algebraically 0.1 * retention in this linear model.

review.strongest_surviving_claim: In the small-strain linearized periodic triangular lattice model with exponential internal strain-memory relaxation, the numerical implementation satisfies exact degree-sequence and directional-edge invariants for alternating-hexagon flips, passes finite-difference gradient and translational-null checks, and shows that fixed-node hub-biased edge concentration (which jointly increases degree variance, triangle clumping, and network fragmentation) consistently reduces stress retention relative to uniform networks for z >= 3.2 at kappa in {0.003, 0.03}, whereas small realized degree-preserving triangle perturbations (0.4% to 2.3% clustering shift) produce near-zero retention changes.
review.decisive_next_experiment: Log active collinear bending motif counts (bends = nb) in the graph summary and execute a targeted sweep at L=24, z in {3.2, 4.0, 4.8} using (1) rejection-free sampling of indexed alternating hexagons with a joint Metropolis penalty on |delta_bends| to test whether larger degree-preserving clustering contrasts (delta clustering >= 0.05) can be achieved at fixed bending motif count, and (2) connectivity-preserving hub swaps that forbid disconnecting the wrapping component or altering triangle counts.

literature_to_verify.reason: Contextualize the complete exclusion of central-force (kappa=0) networks at z <= 3.2 and bending-stabilized networks at z <= 2.4 under the G0 > 1e-6 threshold.
